title: Projekte (Notion)
description: Alle nicht archivierten Projekte aus der Datenbank „Projekte“ im Control Centre.

data.query: SELECT "Projekt-ID" AS id, "Name" AS name, "Status" AS status, "Priorität" AS prio, "Bereich" AS bereich, "Entität" AS entitaet, "Zielbeitrag" AS ziel, "Blocker" AS blocker, "Nächster Meilenstein" AS meilenstein, "date:Deadline:start" AS deadline, "date:Letzter Fortschritt:start" AS fortschritt, url FROM "collection://5da8040d-bbd2-47b1-9eec-c39d3acca8d0" WHERE "Archiviert" IS NULL OR "Archiviert" <> '__YES__' ORDER BY "Bereich", "Projekt-ID"
